title: Groq qwen/qwen3.6-27b model retirement
description: Groq documents that qwen/qwen3.6-27b was shut down on September 14, 2026, with qwen/qwen3.8-27b as the direct successor for affected tiers.
oldBehavior: The application sends requests using the retired qwen/qwen3.6-27b model identifier.
newBehavior: The application sends requests using the documented qwen/qwen3.8-27b replacement identifier.
migrationInstructions: Replace a direct literal model property set to qwen/qwen3.6-27b with qwen/qwen3.8-27b.
Review account tier eligibility and dynamic model configuration before applying the proposal.

evidenceSources.summary: Official Groq deprecation documentation names qwen/qwen3.6-27b and qwen/qwen3.8-27b as its replacement.

review.notes: Reviewed against the official Groq deprecations page. The executable transformation is limited to direct literal model properties; tier and dynamic configuration remain review-only.

assumptions: The source establishes model retirement and a direct successor but not account-specific eligibility.
Only direct static model literals are eligible for a deterministic proposal.
Every generated patch remains subject to verification and human approval.
